projects.name: MnDOT 2026-2035 CHIP - STIP Roadway Projects (years 1-4)
work_type_values: N/A (I.E. NON-MNDOT SELECTION OR NON-TH PROJECT)
projects.notes: Committed (STIP) state highway roadway projects, fiscal years 2026-2029. There is no status field: the layer itself means 'programmed'. Fiscal_Yea is the fiscal year (number), not a letting date. Estimated_ is TEXT such as '$10.6 M' or '$11 - 14 M', not a number. Project_Se is the project selection/investment category (the nearest thing to work type; values have stray spaces and a few bad values such as '65'); the real scope is in the free-text Descriptio. Project_We is a project web link.

projects.name: MnDOT 2026-2035 CHIP - CHIP Roadway Projects (years 5-10)
projects.notes: Planned (not yet committed) roadway projects, fiscal years 2030-2035. Same fields as the STIP roadway layer; cost is a text range.

projects.name: MnDOT Current, Programmed and Planned Construction Projects (combined view)
projects.notes: Alternative single service with three line layers: 58 Current Construction Projects (202 records, under construction - skip), 59 Programmed (STIP, FY2026-2029, 680 records, NO cost field) and 18 Planned (CHIP, 931 records, cost text in Estimated_, status in StatusType = 'Planned Roadway Project' / 'Planned Bridge project '). Bridges are drawn as tiny lines here. The four CHIP layers above carry more attributes.

parcels_statewide.name: Parcels, Compiled from Opt-In Open Data Counties, Minnesota (MnGeo)
parcels_statewide.notes: PARTIAL statewide: 60 of Minnesota's 87 counties have opted in. 2,132,898 of 2,714,438 records have an owner name. Owner names present for Hennepin (447,044), Ramsey, Dakota, Anoka, Washington, St. Louis, Olmsted, Wright; counties such as Scott and Stearns are in the layer but with owner_name empty. When own_add_* is empty (e.g. Hennepin) the taxpayer name and address are in tax_name / tax_add_l1..l4. state_pin is county FIPS + PIN. Site address is split across several fields. Layer 1 of the service is a per-county metadata layer. No restriction is stated on the service; the dataset page licence text was not confirmed.

summary: MnDOT's 10-year plan gives planned projects as lines (roads) and points (bridges) but cost is a text range and there is no letting date, only fiscal year. Parcels with owner names exist for 60 of 87 counties in one MnGeo layer (all the big metro counties except Scott have owners); the other 27 counties are missing.
